authentication.method: identity wrapper, manifest, checkpoint, shard hash, schema, seed, grid, yaw, material, transport, and additive component-closure checks

component_share_definition: Each share is the pooled seed-point mean normalized wbSAR for one additive first-interaction component divided by the corresponding pooled total mean.
disclosures: Geometry-only material priors were used; no panorama-derived semantic evidence was used.
Each site is represented by 64 deterministic points selected from a fixed walkable-ground grid.
The body faces north at every point, so exposure is conditional on a fixed 0 degree ENU yaw.
16 IID seeds quantify screening-scale stochastic variation; convergence was inspected at [4, 8, 16] seeds.
Spatial sensitivity was inspected at [16, 32, 64] evenly stratified points within the declared fixed-grid order.
Values are normalized per unit rho_A P_EIRP and are not deployment-absolute exposures.
The point sets do not support pedestrian-path, population, prevalence, or site-ranking inference.

spatial_sensitivity_definition: The [16, 32, 64]-point looks take evenly stratified receiver subsets from the declared 64-point order while holding the 64-point transmitter curve and the 16-seed mean fixed. They do not measure transmitter-curve uncertainty.
uncertainty_definition: For each spatial quantile, seed_standard_error is the sample standard deviation of the 16 within-seed 64-point quantiles divided by sqrt(16). It is conditional on the fixed grid and does not include spatial-design, material-model, source-model, or orientation uncertainty.
